Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [01 PL, 02 PL, 03 PL, 04 PL, 05 PL, 06 PL, 07 PL, 08 PL, application form, cover letter- Received 17/08/2026; Energy & Sustainability Statement dated 18th August 2020 V4 prepared by Eb7; received 19/08/2020; SuDs Strategy Report FRA2025.1r sustainability services dated 16 July 2020 prepared by Eb7; received 17/07/2020; Letter from Thames Water dated 26th June 2020; received 29/06/2020; Design Report 01 dated 24/06/2020 prepared by autor architecture; received 24/06/2020; Design and Access Statement dated April 2020 prepared by autor architecture, Daylight & Sunlight Report dated 22nd April 2020 prepared eb7, Air Quality Assessment dated 30th March 2020 prepared by eb7, 19096-13-B-T, 19096-13-B-T3, 19096-13-B-T2, 19096-13-B-T4, 19096-13-E-1, 19096-13-B-T5, 19096-13-E-2, 19096-13-E-3-4, 19096-13-E-5, 19096-13-E-6, 19096-13-E-7, 19096-13-E-8-9 Rev A; received 04/05/2020].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 2 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority. 
Reason: To protect neighbouring amenity.
Condition : 3 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the materials approved under discharge application P/2021/1276, as subsequently amended by Non-Material Amendment P/2026/1426, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the development and the surrounding area.
Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the boundary treatment approved under application P/2021/1276 and retained thereafter. Any amendments to the approved details shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To safeguard the visual appearance of the area and residential amenity.
Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Construction Management Plan approved under application P/2021/1276. Any amendments to the approved details shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To ensure highway safety and protect residential amenity.
Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the waste and recycling details approved under application P/2021/1276 and retained thereafter. Any amendments to the approved details shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To ensure satisfactory waste management arrangements.
Condition : 7 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the cycle storage details approved under application P/2021/1276 and retained thereafter. Any amendments to the approved details shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 8 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the units hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To safeguard the visual appearance of the development and residential amenity.
Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the drainage details approved pursuant to planning permission P/2020/1455 under discharge of condition application P/2021/1276, and prior to commencement of the amended development hereby approved, updated drainage details shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details shall demonstrate that the amended development, including the revised building footprint, can be accommodated within the approved drainage strategy and will continue to achieve appropriate surface water attenuation and discharge rates. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details. Any amendments to the approved details shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To ensure that the amended development incorporates satisfactory surface water drainage and does not increase the risk of flooding.
Condition : 10 - Prior to occupation of any dwelling hereby approved, the applicant shall have submitted and had approved by the Local Planning Authority evidence to show that the finalised drainage system has been built to comply with approved final detailed drainage designs to be secured under condition 9 of this consent. This evidence shall include photographs, copies of installation contracts, and written confirmation that the drainage features will be managed as per the detailed maintenance plan for the lifetime of the development.
Reason: To ensure that the methods to mitigate the risk of surface water flooding have been implemented as agreed and that the drainage system is suitably managed.
Condition : 11 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit. Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.
Reason: In order to protect the free flow and safety of traffic on nearby highways and to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 12 - a)	Notwithstanding the approved Energy Strategy and associated details approved pursuant to planning permission P/2020/1455, prior to commencement of the amended development hereby approved, an updated Energy Strategy shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The updated Energy Strategy shall assess the impact of the approved amendments and demonstrate how the development will achieve compliance with the relevant energy and carbon reduction requirements of the development plan. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details. Any amendments to the approved details shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
b)	Prior to first occupation of any dwelling within the development hereby approved evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/National Calculation Method) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
Reason: In order to ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions.
Condition : 13 - Notwithstanding the carbon offset details approved pursuant to planning permission P/2020/1455 under discharge of condition application P/2023/3180, and prior to above-ground works associated with the amendments hereby approved, the applicant shall have submitted and had approved in writing by the local planning authority details demonstrating whether the amended development would result in any changes to the approved carbon emissions and associated carbon offset contribution. Where an additional carbon offset contribution is identified, the applicant shall have entered into a binding arrangement with the Council to secure the required contribution prior to first occupation of the development. Any amendments to the approved details shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order to ensure that the development meets sustainability standards.
Condition : 14 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) hereby approved, the development shall have been constructed to achieve an internal water use of 105 litres/person/day or less.
Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources.
Condition : 15 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the sustainable materials details approved under application P/2021/1276. Any amendments to the approved details shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To ensure sustainable construction practices.
Condition : 16 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the landscaping details approved under application P/2021/1276 and maintained thereafter. Any amendments to the approved details shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To secure a satisfactory appearance and quality of amenity space.
Condition : 17 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the contaminated land investigation, remediation and verification details approved pursuant to planning permission P/2020/1455. Any amendments to the approved remediation or verification measures shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To ensure that the development is implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public health, environmental protection and safety.
Condition : 18 - Unit 2 (dwg ref 03 PL) of the ground floor dwellings shall be designed as a fully adapted wheelchair home that meets Building Regulation M4(3) part 2(b) 'wheelchair user dwellings'. 
Reason: In order to ensure that the development complies with inclusive design principles.
Note: You can find additional detail in Habinteg Housing Association's Wheelchair Housing Design Guide, 3rd edition and their Lifetime Homes Design Guide.

Condition : 19 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing vehicular access along Hanworth Road shall have been closed permanently and kerbs/verge/footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.
Reason: In order to enhance the pedestrian environment and to ensure highway safety.
Note: Since the cobbles forming the existing crossover are considered to be of heritage value, their retention is supported, subject to the submission and approval of appropriate details through the separate highways application process, with an arrangement comprising full-height granite kerbs along the footway frontage and the re-laying of the retained cobbles flush with the adjacent asphalt footway.
